purpose: Authored source-bound procedural profiles for deliberate selection. These records do not establish an actual committee, vote, SCC acceptance or DGC transition election.

sources.representation: Complete web text extraction of Edition 7; original PDF byte identity not asserted.

profiles.title: SCC national technical specification — flexible route
notes: At least limited peer review; full public commenting is optional in the acquired public guidance.
Record need, public/stakeholder notice, technical expertise, draft, technical consensus evidence, publication and maintenance.
No universal numerical approval fraction or fixed public-review duration is established by this source. Any selected additional rule requires its own authority.
A type-specific non-accredited route does not establish a bidder's separate RFP eligibility.

profiles.title: SCC national PAS guidance — 2021 flexible route
profiles.public_review_modality: normally; flexible guidance, not a universal mandatory minimum
notes: Sections 3.2.3 and 4.6.5 describe normally four weeks of public consultation.
Section 4.6.6 describes simple-majority steering-group approval, sponsor endorsement and developer responsibility for the final publication decision. Record these as separate actions.
Steering-group balance need not follow the ordinary National Standard model. The chair addresses conflicts and comments are disposed before publication.
Typical steering-group 8–12 and review-panel 20–150 sizes are descriptive rather than hard admission thresholds.
This source presents flexible guidelines. Retain an explicit approved project procedure for any justified variation.

lifecycle.then: Transform into a national/international standard or withdraw.

profiles.title: SCC workshop agreement — flexible route
notes: Use an open workshop process outside a technical committee, with an identified need, stakeholder invitation, retained discussion/outcomes and circulated draft for comment and general agreement.
The current SCC page describes publication within two calendar months of the workshop.
No universal numerical ballot or fixed public-comment period is established in this source.

profiles.title: SCC community-sourced guidance — flexible route
notes: Use a structured non-accredited community process with a moderated, accessible online platform; identify objectives, suitable contributions, transparent/fair decisions and maintenance.
The acquired public source establishes no universal numerical ballot or fixed review duration.
A project-specific moderation, review and maintenance policy must be selected explicitly.

profiles.title: DGSI Edition 7 with explicitly selected 2019 SCC basis

interest_balance.rule: No single interest group equals or exceeds the combined other groups.

profiles.urgent_review_basis: Documented urgent health, safety or environmental need.
notes: DGSI 4.9 requires affirmative votes from more than half the participants, at least two-thirds of votes cast affirmative, and no more than one-quarter of votes cast negative.
2019 SCC 6.7 excludes unjustified negatives/abstentions and unreturned/blank ballots from votes cast; its affirmative fraction does not explicitly exclude justified abstentions.
Keep raw eligible/yes/no/abstain/nonresponse and reasons. Show both denominator interpretations until the selected authority records its source-bound rule.
DGSI's additional negative fraction also needs an explicit denominator policy.
Dispose comments and negative votes and notify the affected voter; the independent procedural reviewer was not involved in development.
Do not apply this ordinary-standard profile automatically to TS/PAS/WA/CSG.

profiles.title: DGSI Edition 7 with explicitly selected 2025 SCC basis

interest_balance.rule: No single interest group equals or exceeds the combined other groups.

profiles.urgent_review_basis: Documented urgent health, safety or environmental need.
notes: 2025 SCC 6.7.1(b) explicitly excludes abstentions from the two-thirds affirmative denominator.
Ordinary 6.7.1(a1) still requires affirmative votes from more than half the eligible members.
The alternative a2 participation threshold including abstentions applies specifically to joint Canada–US development, not every project.
The additional DGSI one-quarter negative fraction is retained with its own unresolved denominator; do not silently borrow the affirmative definition.
All original comments/negative dispositions, notifications and independent procedural-review obligations remain.

transition.notes: An existing SDO may use the earlier accreditation/adoption basis during transition or elect version 6. No acquired source establishes DGC's actual election.

notes: Keep awarded budget, actual eligible costs, phase invoices, accepted deliverables and collected payments separate.
The original four-phase deliverables and financial table apply independently of the selected standards-process profile.
